title: Lemon Ricotta Chicken Pasta
steps:
Boil the spaghetti.
Save 1 cup of
pasta water

Oregano on the chicken.
Sear to 165°F,
then slice

Ricotta + Parmesan
+ lemon + garlic.
Toss with spinach
vo: One pot, one skillet, dinner in thirty minutes.
You need spaghetti, chicken breast, ricotta, Parmesan, a lemon, garlic, oregano, spinach and a baguette.
Boil the spaghetti, and save a cup of the pasta water before you drain it.
Season the chicken with oregano, sear it until it hits one sixty-five inside, then slice it.
Whisk ricotta, Parmesan, lemon and garlic with hot pasta water, toss with the spaghetti and spinach, and top with the chicken.
